from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MinorityInterestRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of minority interest extracted from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    minority_interest_value: float = Field(description="The value of minority interest for the reporting period")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The specific reporting period covered, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency of the reported amount, e.g., 'CNY'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the document containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    minority_interest_records: list[MinorityInterestRecord]
